indicator_name: Crude Oil Price, Brent spot (World Bank Pink Sheet)
description: Цена нефти Brent (Всемирный банк, Pink Sheet)
methodology: US dollars per barrel, monthly average of daily Brent (38° API) spot quotations as published in the World Bank Pink Sheet (nominal). A world benchmark, not the Kazakh export price: KEBCO trades at a differential to Brent. File release: September 02, 2026.
